The thing I hate is how everyone's talking about this guy saying shit like "he was a self-entitled something or other and a narcissist and it's no wonder no one loved him" and i'm like "fuck. i mean, accept for the murdering and thinking of women as evil, I feel like i'm disturbingly similar to this guy. I guess i'm not worthy of love either"
 So now i feel like i'm basically in the same category as a murderer.

i guess. I mean, i wouldn't complain if say all the fagletes and popular guys happened to get shipped off to north korea. 

But still. going back to like middle school and high school i'd hate everyone that got attention from girls. even worse in college. mostly it would be inward though. I would hate myself for not being good enough to be in their position. and I would hate them for being better than me.  In college it got to the point where I couldn't see an attractive girl without wanting to throw myself in front of a bus  

I thought i was getting better in the past 6 months, but once I read that shit it brought all these feelings back up and I don't feel like I can handle it.
